background: Debra A. Surratt, listed as Debbi Surratt on the official assessor page, is the Goshen County assessor, serving through the end of the current term in January 2027. County salary publications (used here for job titles only) list her as county assessor. Incoming assessor Jeremy Wardell, who is listed as deputy assessor on the official staff directory, takes office in January 2027.
